analysis:
Compared all supplied BASE/HEAD source, patches and metadata against the canonical definition index and selected T-041 detail. ProviderLoop.swift head 719–730 adds selected-model recovery state, an optional load override and saved selection snapshots; head 882 initializes the saved filter without changing initial serving selection. ProviderLoop+Testing.swift head 514–522 adds internal override/wait seams; no new external invocation path is shown. ProviderLoop+Trust.swift head 50–54 persists enabled-model snapshots and a recovery report alongside existing model diagnostics. Authorization clearing and trust-status persistence remain unchanged (head 148–170). These visible changes do not independently establish an authorization, encryption, billing or data-exposure regression; existing cache controls are not modified in this scope.
Integration must examine the new ProviderLoop+SelectedModelRecovery implementation and its callers, override use, and selectedModelRecoveryReport/DaemonState encoding. Material questions are whether recovery respects serving selection, cancellation/shutdown, memory admission and add-on holds (A-018, TB-007, TB-012, T-010, T-029, T-059), retains verified weight/cache bindings (T-012, T-027, T-041), and cannot outlive connection authorization (T-053). The report's actual fields must be checked for sensitive diagnostics (A-001, T-058). Those implementations are outside the supplied source scope; their absence is a coverage limit, not evidence of a missing control. No supported finding arises from the declarations, seams or snapshot additions alone.
